mapper.select: SELECT password_hash FROM review_admin WHERE username=#{username}
SELECT id,username,display_name FROM review_admin WHERE id=#{id} AND enabled=1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT id,role,nickname,organization AS affiliation,verification_status,review_id FROM publisher_user UNION ALL SELECT id,role,nickname,school AS affiliation,verification_status,review_id FROM student_user) u WHERE u.verification_status='PENDING' AND u.role=#{role}

SELECT u.*,e.created_at AS submitted_at FROM (SELECT id,role,nickname,organization AS affiliation,verification_status,review_id FROM publisher_user UNION ALL SELECT id,role,nickname,school AS affiliation,verification_status,review_id FROM student_user) u LEFT JOIN verification_event e ON e.id=u.review_id WHERE u.verification_status='PENDING' AND u.role=#{role} ORDER BY e.created_at,u.id LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT status,note,created_at FROM verification_event WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT a.*,r.display_name AS reviewer,u.role,u.nickname,u.affiliation FROM review_action a JOIN review_admin r ON r.id=a.admin_id JOIN (SELECT id,role,nickname,organization AS affiliation,verification_status,review_id FROM publisher_user UNION ALL SELECT id,role,nickname,school AS affiliation,verification_status,review_id FROM student_user) u ON u.id=a.user_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offset}
